title: Condensation.
officialText:
All refrigerating piping and fittings, brine piping and fittings that, during normal operation, will reach a
surface temperature below the dew point of the surrounding air, and are located in spaces or areas where condensation will cause a
safety hazard to the building occupants, structure, electrical equipment or any other equipment or appliances, shall be protected in
an approved manner to prevent such damage.
